<h2>Interpolate Grouped Time Series</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Interpolates grouped numeric time series to a regular age grid.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>interpolate_grouped_time_series(
  data_time_series = NULL,
  grouping_variables = "dataset_name",
  age_variable_name = "age",
  value_variable_name = "value",
  interpolation_method = "linear",
  extrapolation_rule = 1,
  ties_function = base::mean,
  age_min = 0,
  age_max = 12000,
  time_step = 500,
  n_cores = 1,
  show_progress = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_time_series">data_time_series</code></td>
<td>
<p>A data frame containing grouping, age, and value columns.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="grouping_variables">grouping_variables</code></td>
<td>
<p>A character vector of column names that define independent time series.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="age_variable_name">age_variable_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Name of the numeric age column.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="value_variable_name">value_variable_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Name of the numeric value column.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="interpolation_method">interpolation_method</code></td>
<td>
<p>Interpolation method passed to [stats::approx()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="extrapolation_rule">extrapolation_rule</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric extrapolation rule passed to [stats::approx()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="ties_function">ties_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Function used by [stats::approx()] to combine tied ages.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="age_min">age_min</code></td>
<td>
<p>Minimum age in the output grid.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="age_max">age_max</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum age in the output grid.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="time_step">time_step</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive spacing between consecutive ages in the output grid.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="n_cores">n_cores</code></td>
<td>
<p>Number of workers. Use '1' for sequential 'purrr::map()' execution or a
larger integer for parallel 'furrr::future_map()' execution.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="show_progress">show_progress</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical indicating whether supported map operations display progress.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Each unique combination of 'grouping_variables' is interpolated
independently with [stats::approx()]. Groups that cannot be interpolated
return no rows.
</p>
<p>Parallel execution temporarily owns the active 'future' plan. The previous
plan is restored when the function exits.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A data frame containing the grouping columns and interpolated age and value
columns.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[stats::approx()]
</p>

</main>
